Copper alloy Coin. Possibly Barbarous Radiate, issue of 275-285, Reece period 14. Obverse description: Radiate bust probably cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--] SC AVG. Reverse description: Stick figure standing left, right arm extended holding ?wand. Reverse inscription: [--] V GCliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter:16.7mm, Weight: 2.22gms, die axis: 8
